sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Hello.
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 你好。

sentences.en: Um my family and I are staying here in Trebirch for a week or two and we wanted to know about the train services.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我和我的家人将在特雷比奇住一周或两周，我们想了解一下火车服务情况。

sentences.en: We're hoping to do a few local trips.
sentences.zh: 我们打算在当地做几次短途旅行。

sentences.en: RAILPERSON: OK.
sentences.zh: RAILPERSON: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, I can give you lots of details about all the trains going from Trebirch in the South West.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我可以向您详细介绍所有从西南部特雷比奇出发的列车信息。

sentences.en: This leaflet will be very helpful but can tell you some of the main things.
sentences.zh: 这本小册子会非常有帮助，但我也可以告诉您一些主要信息。

sentences.en: We've got two main train stations in the town.
sentences.zh: 镇上有两个主要火车站。

sentences.en: King Street is for local commuter lines and regional services.
sentences.zh: 国王街站服务于本地通勤线路和区域列车。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: What about trains to London?
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 那去伦敦的火车呢？

sentences.en: I'll need to go there on business for one day.
sentences.zh: 我需要去那里出差一天。

sentences.en: RAILPERSON: Then you need to go to Central Station - that's for all - the national services.
sentences.zh: RAILPERSON: 那您得去中央车站——所有全国性列车服务都在那里。

sentences.en: There are regular trains to London.
sentences.zh: 有定期开往伦敦的列车。

sentences.en: They leave Trebirch every half hour on weekdays and every hour at weekends.
sentences.zh: 工作日每半小时一班，周末每小时一班。

sentences.en: It takes about two Q/3 hours, a bit longer on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 全程约需两又三分之一小时，周日稍长一些。

sentences.en: You've got a choice of first and second class and there's a buffet car - though refreshments are included in the 014 cost of a first class ticket.
sentences.zh: 您可选择一等座或二等座，列车上还设有餐车——不过一等座车票价格（014）已包含餐饮服务。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Ah right.
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 啊，明白了。

sentences.en: Um, and have you got any information on different ticket types?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你们有关于不同车票类型的资料吗？

sentences.en: RAILPERSON: Yes.
sentences.zh: RAILPERSON: 有。

sentences.en: There's a range of ticket prices depending on when you travel and when you buy your ticket.
sentences.zh: 车票价格种类繁多，取决于您的乘车时间和购票时间。

sentences.en: There's a standard open ticket which doesn't have any restrictions.
sentences.zh: 有一种标准开放式车票，没有任何限制。

sentences.en: This can be bought in advance or on the day.
sentences.zh: 这种车票可以提前购买，也可以当天购买。

sentences.en: You www.TopSage.com 7. 3-P can also get various discounted tickets.
sentences.zh: 您还可以购买多种折扣车票。

sentences.en: A popular one is called the Supersave and, er, this is OK for travel after 8.45.
sentences.zh: 其中一种很受欢迎的叫‘超级省钱票’，适用于8:45之后出发的列车。

sentences.en: Then there is the Sage.com Special ticket, which is valid for travel after 10.15.
sentences.zh: 还有一种叫‘智者网特别票’，适用于10:15之后出发的列车。

sentences.en: The Special tickets are also valid for travel at weekends.
sentences.zh: 特别票在周末也可使用。

sentences.en: The cheapest tickets are called Advance and you have to buy them at least six days ahead.
sentences.zh: 最便宜的车票叫‘提前预订票’，您必须至少提前六天购买。

sentences.en: Only a certain @16 number are available and you have to make seat reservations for these.
sentences.zh: 这类车票数量有限，且必须提前预订座位。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Thanks.
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And are there lots of places to go to around here?
sentences.zh: 这附近还有许多值得去的地方吗？

sentences.en: RAILPERSON: Oh yes.
sentences.zh: RAILPERSON: 哦，当然有。

sentences.en: You can enjoy many days out.
sentences.zh: 您可以安排多次一日游。

sentences.en: Um there's the Merthyr Mining /19/20 Museum, which is only half an hour from Trebirch by train.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有梅瑟蒂德菲尔矿业博物馆，乘火车仅需半小时即可从特雷比奇抵达。

sentences.en: Your children will find it just as fascinating as any theme park and they can ride in the original miners' lifts and on the coal trains.
sentences.zh: 您的孩子会觉得它和任何主题公园一样有趣，他们还能乘坐原始矿工升降机和运煤列车。

sentences.en: There are special excursion tickets which include entrance fees.
sentences.zh: 有专门的游览套票，含入场费。

sentences.en: Mainline trains also offer direct services to Bristol, where you can visit the docks or spend a 018/19/20 great day out with the children in the zoo, which is set in the parkland that used to surround the old castle.
sentences.zh: 干线列车还提供直达布里斯托尔的服务，您可参观码头，或带孩子在动物园度过愉快的一天——该动物园坐落于昔日古堡环绕的公园林地之中。

sentences.en: Er, special family awayday fares are available for this service now during the school holidays.
sentences.zh: 目前学校假期期间，该线路还提供特别的家庭一日游优惠票价。

sentences.en: Er, alternatively, you can be in Birmingham in only an hour and a half, where there's lots to see and do including the new and internationally- acclaimed climbing wall built on the site of the old aquarium.
sentences.zh: 嗯，另外，您只需一个半小时便可抵达伯明翰，那里有许多景点和活动可供体验，包括建在旧水族馆原址上的全新国际知名攀岩墙。

sentences.en: We will /19/20 also be running a special service to Newport when the new science museum opens next year, as we anticipate a lot of visitors in the opening weeks.
sentences.zh: 明年新科学博物馆在纽波特开馆时，我们还将开通前往纽波特的特别列车服务，因为预计开馆初期将吸引大量游客。

sentences.en: I'd advise you to call early to book your tickets.
sentences.zh: 我建议您尽早致电预订车票。

sentences.en: Is that OK?
sentences.zh: 这样可以吗？

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Yes, thanks.
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 是的，谢谢。
